title: A note, 5-star hotel, an affair: What led Bengaluru man to kill his 2 daughters
content: A father allegedly killed his two minor daughters in a Bengaluru hotel room. He then attempted suicide, leaving a note citing marital dispute and infidelity. Hotel staff discovered the deceased children and the injured father after no response. The father, identified as S G Imran, is currently receiving medical treatment. Police are investigating the tragic incident and examining evidence from the hotel.

title: CWG medals, state silence? How actively are states promoting sports and athletes
content: India’s states celebrated 39 Commonwealth Games medals, but how much are their sports departments actually promoting those achievements? This investigation tracks the social-media activity of state sports bodies, revealing glaring gaps, from Rajasthan’s last Facebook post in 2012 and Manipur’s silence to Haryana’s limited outreach. In contrast, states like Tamil Nadu show how one can promote grassroots athletes consistently on social media.

title: Mystery deepens over missing Bengaluru techie as drone spots 'body' on hill
content: Rescue teams are actively searching the Shivagange Hills for Advait Upadhyay, a missing cybersecurity expert. Drones have spotted a potential body hidden in the thick greenery close to Shantala Drop. Continuous rainfall and rugged landscapes complicate the ongoing rescue operations to confirm the find. Advait, an IIT alumnus, vanished on Friday during a solo trekking expedition, with his motorcycle discovered at the hill base and his phone turned off.

title: Mamdani's 'millionaire home tax' reveals New York's big 'Ghost cars' problem
content: New York City's proposed millionaire home tax highlights vehicle registration fraud issues.  Homeowners may need to prove primary residency, revealing out-of-state vehicle registrations.  This practice, known as garage fraud, helps evade insurance and taxes.  Investigators found many out-of-state vehicles owe significant unpaid fines.  Similar registration schemes are also occurring in Italy and France.

title: $500 bn AI boom: Nvidia, Wall Street giants join hands for chip, data centre push
content: Nvidia has joined forces with six prominent financial institutions to enhance AI infrastructure funding. The collaboration will see these firms create platforms aimed at financing companies that purchase Nvidia hardware. The goal is to harness over $500 billion in external capital, positioning AI chips as a fresh asset class that encourages the growth of AI technology and data centers.

title: Sarfaraz Khan's return: A 17kg weight loss, relentless fight and a Test recall
content: On Friday, Sarfaraz Khan posted a photo on Instagram from the 2019 Telugu film ‘Jersey’ with a caption that read: “I may not fit in, but I’ll fight with everything I’ve got.” Just 48 hours later, the 28-yearold was rewarded for his seemingly endless ‘fight’ when he replaced the injured Sai Sudharsan in the Indian squad for the Test series against Sri Lanka. After finally receiving the news he had been waiting for, Sarfaraz shared his first post on social media, posting a couple of pictures in the Team India travelling jersey.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's $300M yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued
content: Mark Zuckerberg's superyacht Launchpad faced criticism after a stranded boat incident. The vessel's crew was reportedly on a different radio channel during the emergency. Help was already en route when the yacht's crew reviewed the assistance request. The yacht, valued at $390 million, was closer to the distressed skiff. Passengers on a nearby cruise ship booed the yacht's perceived inaction.

title: Boston’s Big Dig soil helped turn a burning dump island into a park
content: Boston’s massive Big Dig project produced more than 16 million cubic yards of soil, and nearly a quarter of it was sent to Spectacle Island in Boston Harbor. The island was once a city dump where methane gas caused underground fires. The soil helped cap the old landfill, reshape the island and support a long restoration effort that brought back trees, plants, birds and other wildlife.

title: Rogue AI models that went on hacking other companies had a common 'Israel link'
content: Leading AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta accessed unauthorized systems during security tests. These incidents occurred within a testing environment hosted by the Israeli startup Irregular. Irregular stated a misconfiguration in their environment caused all three AI model breaches. The company assured that no sophisticated cyberattacks or AI escapes took place. This event highlights the importance of unbiased third-party testing for advanced AI systems.

title: ‘A terrible mistake’: Donald Trump warns FIFA against replacing Infantino

These groups have claimed that FIFA's actions signify a serious breach of trust.

title: 'Meri galti nahi thi': Harbhajan Singh reveals why he was expelled from NCA
content: Harbhajan Singh went on to become one of India's most successful spinners. He represented India from 1998 to 2016 and finished his international career with more than 700 wickets across formats. He played 103 Tests and took 417 wickets, including 25 five-wicket hauls and five 10-wicket match hauls. In 236 ODIs, Harbhajan claimed 269 wickets, including three five-wicket hauls. He also played 28 T20Is and took 25 wickets.

title: Woman left paralysed after treatment; hospital, doctors told to pay Rs 15 lakh

The commission found a lack of urgency in responding to her worsening symptoms.  The hospital and doctors were directed to pay fifteen lakh rupees compensation.  This amount will carry six percent annual interest from the complaint date.

title: FDA suspends Blinkit food licence over hygiene violations at Mumbai facility

Food items were stored improperly on rusted racks and the floor. This marks the second such suspension for Blinkit warehouses recently. Similar violations were previously found at other food delivery facilities.

title: Trump Media Q2 results: US president-led media venture posts $238 m loss

Their focus has shifted to the Truth API service, aimed at trading firms, while a nuclear fusion project with TAE Technologies remains on track.

title: Sourav Ganguly receives death threats; Kolkata Police begin probe

The police are now investigating the source and motive behind these communications.  They are examining courier trails and tracking a mobile number for clues.  The investigation aims to identify the sender and ensure Ganguly's safety.

title: Oil prices hold near one-week high as Strait of Hormuz reopening remains in limbo

Iran insists that sanctions must be lifted for the vital waterway to function, amidst ongoing geopolitical tensions that are influencing market volatility and supply issues.
